system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Prompts are dynamically assembled from pre- and post-commit code segments, commit messages, and structured metadata.
system_prompt_style.note: Paper-only coding. The linked repo is the Linux kernel, not AutoDriver's code. Each taxonomy type has its own template.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Instead of supplying complete driver files to the model, the engine extracts local context windows centered around affected functions or structures.
env_context_strategy.note: The harness injects context extracted by Linux LSP rather than letting the model navigate. No value fits exactly; this is the closest (ambiguity).

observation_format.evidence_quote: the error analysis module parses compiler diagnostics and returns structured feedback to the Coding Agent
observation_format.note: Feedback consists of compiler diagnostics fed back into the prompt.

tool_call_format.note: The model emits unified-diff patches; no tool-call syntax is described.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: syntax validationconfirms that each patch adheres to the unified diff format, checks hunk headers and line numbers

protocol_standardization.note: Linux LSP (Language Server Protocol) is used for localization, but not as an agent-tool protocol.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: If the build fails, the error analysis module parses compiler diagnostics and returns structured feedback to the Coding Agent, which regenerates or adjusts the patch.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: AUTODRIVER is designed as a multi-stage pipeline that transforms structured case packs from DRIVEBENCH into validated driver patches.
planning_granularity.note: Fixed pipeline; no planning step is described.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: This input is processed by a coordinated set of agents—Prompt Engineering, Coding, Patch Fix, and Static Analysis—operating within an iterative refinement loop.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: returns structured feedback to the Coding Agent, which regenerates or adjusts the patch
delegation_mechanism.note: Closest fit: hand-off between specialized agent roles.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Each iteration generates logs and metadata, which are appended to the originating case pack for reproducibility

long_term_memory.note: A learning module that tunes prompts is described as under development.

self_verification.evidence_quote: type/ABI checks and kernel-idiom linters, followed bybuild→ QEMU boot→ run-time oraclesthat include fast smoke checks, full func-tional tests

retry_policy.evidence_quote: This error-driven regeneration continues for a con-figurable number of attempts (default 5–10)

rollback.evidence_quote: The system au-tomatically restores the source tree, applies the patch, and launches incremental builds.
rollback.note: The source tree is restored before each build; this is a harness reset, not model rollback.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: This error-driven regeneration continues for a con-figurable number of attempts (default 5–10)

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: The system automatically performs patch synthesis, format verification, compilation, and runtime testing inside isolated Docker environments.
execution_isolation.note: QEMU is also used for runtime tests.

permission_model.evidence_quote: A configurable threshold (default 0.7) filters low-quality patches from entering the build stage.
permission_model.note: Static gate on patches; closest fit.

tracing.evidence_quote: Each iteration generates logs and metadata, which are appended to the originating case pack

replayability.evidence_quote: A replayer utility reconstructs any pack end-to-end
replayability.note: The replayer is for case packs rather than agent trajectories.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: Each adaptation session produces a detailed report summariz-ing LLM generation success, compilation success, and run-time validation results

target_domain.evidence_quote: a closed-loop, LLM-driven system for automating driver main-tenance

open_source.note: The paper claims release of the tooling, but the linked repo is the Linux kernel, not AutoDriver.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Two genera-tion engines are tested under identical conditions:ChatGPT andDeepSeek.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: LLM-Driven Kernel Evolution: Automating Driver Updates in Linux
primary_artifact.note: No AutoDriver repository is present in the evidence.

first_release_date.note: Based on the paper v1 date.
